name: nalfeshnee
lore:
From the stinking depths of the Abyss crawls the Nalfeshnee, a grotesque parody of nobility. These corpulent demons, blending the worst features of boar and ape, stand as judges and rulers in their twisted fiefdoms. Do not be fooled by their gluttonous appearance and crude manners, for beneath their swinish exterior lies a cunning intellect, one that coldly categorizes all beings as "fit to eat," "fit to use," or "fit to serve."

Perched atop flaming thrones, Nalfeshnees preside over the damned souls arriving from the Mountain of Woe, whimsically transforming them into lesser demons to fill the ranks of the Abyss. They claim to possess a keen eye for demonic potential, but their judgments are as chaotic as the plane they rule. While they may outwardly obey greater powers like demon lords and balors, their inherent treachery leads them to undermine plans and sow discord, even at the expense of the Blood War itself.

To encounter a Nalfeshnee is to confront a being of immense power and insatiable hunger. Their brutish strength and vile magics are augmented by the ability to summon other demons and to smite their foes with visions of their deepest fears. Whether brawling on the battlefield or scheming from their abyssal courts, Nalfeshnees are a constant reminder of the depravity and chaos that festers at the heart of the Abyss.
